propositions: Duplicate tickets are currently discovered only mid-implementation because create_core performs no duplicate or similarity check at creation time, by design per ADR 0086.
Same-title true duplicates are created within 171 seconds of their twin with 100% precision when constrained to normalized-title match plus 600-second recency window, measured on 2679-ticket store.

A rolling recent-creates.json sidecar journal keyed by normalized title, probed under fcntl.flock within create_core, enables O(window) advisory-only duplicate surfacing without write-path regression.
The advisory warning surfaces on CLI stderr, library dict, and MCP result field after successful creation (exit 0) and names the candidate ticket id, status, and age.
Linking closed duplicate tickets requires reopen-link-re-close sequence; rebar transition with --class duplicate is exempt from completion verification via _administrative_disposition short-circuit.
The feature is gated on the existing verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets config key and carries zero footprint when disabled.
